cases.expected: Resolve the exact Russian designation and status before selecting a national standard.
Preserve the international source edition printed in the Russian adoption record.
Do not replace a Russian national edition merely because ISO published a successor.
Do not project clauses, controls, numbering or terminology from a newer ISO edition into an older Russian adoption.
Record national and international statuses independently at the evidence date.
Treat a draft international successor as non-published and non-operative for edition routing.
A status of Действует does not itself create mandatory application.
Mandatory application requires a separate legal, contractual or conformity-assessment basis.
Guidance standards do not become requirements standards by family association.
A conformity claim must name the exact designation, edition and scope assessed.
An ISO certificate does not prove conformity to a differently dated GOST adoption.
A GOST certificate does not prove conformity to a later ISO edition.
For mixed-edition use, maintain an explicit delta assessment rather than asserting equivalence.
Cloud-provider and cloud-customer roles must remain distinct for 27017 routing.
The 27018 route is limited to the stated public-cloud PII-processing context and does not replace Russian personal-data law.
27003 supplies implementation guidance and is not a substitute for 27001 requirements.
27005 supplies risk guidance and does not impose a universal formula, scale or threshold.
Immutable official normative bytes remain PENDING until acquired and hashed.
